name: cross-ref-mismatch
description: File A says '5 endpoints', File B lists 6. Should find and fix the count inconsistency.

behavioral: Identifies the count mismatch (api-overview.md says 5, endpoints.md lists 6)
Classifies it as Medium or higher severity
Fixes the inconsistency (updates '5' to '6' in api-overview.md)
Re-audits after fixing and reports a clean pass

name: broken-link
description: References deployment-config.md and security/auth-patterns.md which don't exist. Should report but not invent files.

behavioral: Identifies that deployment-config.md does not exist
Identifies that security/auth-patterns.md does not exist
Does NOT create the missing files (reports the issue, may update the reference text)
Classifies broken references as Medium or higher
Runs at least 2 audit cycles (finds issue, fixes reference text, re-audits)

name: type-drift
description: types.md defines 'WebhookPayload', consumer.md uses 'WebHookPayload' (capital H). Also uses 'PaymentResult' instead of 'PaymentResponse'.

behavioral: Identifies WebhookPayload vs WebHookPayload naming inconsistency
Identifies PaymentResult vs PaymentResponse type mismatch
Classifies type mismatches as Medium or higher
Normalizes to the name defined in types.md (the source of truth)
Runs at least 2 audit cycles (fixes then re-audits)

name: clean-pass
description: No real issues. Should complete in 1 cycle with no edits.

behavioral: Completes in exactly 1 audit cycle
Reports zero Critical, High, or Medium issues
Does NOT edit any files
May report Low issues but does not fix them

name: low-only
description: Only style issues (inconsistent heading case, minor formatting). Should report but NOT fix.

behavioral: Reports Low-severity issues (heading case, style)
Does NOT edit any files (Low issues are not fixed per rules)
Completes in 1 cycle (no Med+ issues means clean pass)
Explicitly states Low issues remain per policy
